text_block_list.text:
A fan letter from a child arrived for 
Super Creek.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"‘When I grow up, I want to become an 
Umamusume just like you, Big Sis’... is 
what it said."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
There were traces of things being erased 
over and over with an eraser.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"They must have taken their time and 
poured their heart into writing this."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, how lovely. Whatever shall I write 
in my thank-you reply?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh my... That's so romantic and wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"There isn't much I can do for this child 
right now, but..."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'll have to do my best in preparation for 
the day we can run together♪

"That day, Super Creek threw herself into 
training with a beaming smile and a light, 
cheerful step."
